description.text: An expansion pack of the Pokémon Card Game series, released on 30 June 2005 and themed on the mythical Mew, led by Mew ex. Regice, Regirock and Registeel return as its Star cards, and it adds a run of strategic Trainers. The cards are numbered to 86. In English it became EX Legend Maker, released in February 2006, after EX Delta Species, the English version of the Japanese set that followed it.
